description: Reverse-ETL sink: mirror an upstream DataFrame into Workable candidates via search-then-write. Workable supports an exact-match email filter, so this finds the candidate by email, then updates the match (and optionally moves its pipeline stage) or creates a new candidate (via a job pipeline or the account-wide talent pool).

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset or inline source. Each row -> one Workable candidate (upserted by matching on email).

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata (rows_created / rows_updated / rows_errored / rows_skipped_no_key). No downstream data -- write side effect lands in Workable.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Asset providing the DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with source.

source.label: Source
source.description: Inline source config (sql/csv/inline). Mutually exclusive with upstream_asset_key.

email_column.label: Email Column
email_column.description: Upstream column holding the candidate's email (Workable match key).

name_column.label: Name Column
name_column.description: Upstream column holding the candidate's full name (used on CREATE, mapped to Workable's name field).

job_shortcode.label: Job Shortcode
job_shortcode.description: If set, new candidates are created via POST /jobs/{shortcode}/candidates. If unset, created via POST /talent_pool/candidates.

fields_map.label: Fields Map
fields_map.description: Upstream column -> Workable candidate field (e.g. phone, summary, address, cover_letter). Applied on both create and update.

stage_column.label: Stage Column
stage_column.description: Upstream column holding a target pipeline stage slug. If present on an existing match, triggers a move. Requires member_id.

member_id.label: Member Id
member_id.description: Acting Workable account member id. Required only if stage_column is used.

max_rows.label: Max Rows
max_rows.description: Safety cap on total rows per run.

name: Workable Candidate Upsert
